homepage_eliza.marketing.footerMissionBo: And their time back, not stolen. Cypherpunk roots, open source forever: cryptography and agency for the individual, against surveillance and capture. We play to win, but we win by giving people control, not by taking their attention.

homepage_eliza.marketing.whyBody: AI can finally do things, not just chat. The winning layer is an operating system: persistent, form-factor-agnostic, open. That layer belongs to whoever owns your data, or it's open. We build the open one.
homepage_eliza.marketing.gadgetGraveyard: Rabbit R1: mass returns, missed payroll. Humane: returns outpaced sales, devices bricked. Meta bought Limitless, Amazon bought Bee. A standalone gadget that replaces your phone is a kill-zone. We don't build there.
homepage_eliza.marketing.osPlayBody: Be the OS the devices run, not the device. Phone, desktop, USB-boot, Raspberry Pi, home devices. Hardware is the wedge; the OS, community and cloud are the moat. The Red Hat playbook for the agent era.
homepage_eliza.marketing.wedgeOneBody: Telemetry-stripped private phones for gov and regulated enterprise. Compliance-gated, sovereignty-first: the one lane the giants can't enter.
homepage_eliza.marketing.wedgeTwoBody: ~30M US adults whose lives are hard to manage. $6B+ TAM, high willingness to pay, a segment Apple and Google won't target. Peer, not savior.
homepage_eliza.marketing.wedgeThreeBody: An 18k-star community: distribution engine, contributor base, and free QA army. The layer that feeds the enterprise business.
homepage_eliza.marketing.wedgeTitle: Start where Big Tech can't follow.
homepage_eliza.marketing.wedgeBody: Apple and Google's entire business model is telemetry. They cannot credibly ship a private, no-tracking sovereign device. The cypherpunks were right: privacy in an open society requires it in software. That's exactly where elizaOS wins first, and it's real, not a slide.
homepage_eliza.marketing.stackLayerOneBo: The interface, on the devices you already carry.
homepage_eliza.marketing.stackLayerTwoBo: Ambient capture and memory, as software, running on hardware you already own. No wearable to manufacture, no kill-zone.
homepage_eliza.marketing.stackLayerThree: The open agent OS. Runs anywhere: phone, USB-boot, Pi, robots, home devices. The default OS for agent devices.
homepage_eliza.marketing.stackLayerFourB: Where the agent lives and persists. Self-host free; hosted subscription for convenience. Our compute cost edge makes the margins real.
homepage_eliza.marketing.stackBody: elizaOS delivers a persistent personal agent as a system, not an app you open, a presence that's always there. Free and open to self-host. Hosted convenience and enterprise support are the business.
homepage_eliza.marketing.dealStepOneBody: Private, telemetry-stripped devices for government and regulated enterprise, where an open, auditable, no-tracking OS isn't a preference, it's a procurement requirement. The one lane the giants structurally can't enter.
homepage_eliza.marketing.dealStepTwoBody: The same OS runs everywhere: phone, desktop, USB-boot, Pi, home devices, robots. The open-source community carries it; the hosted cloud monetizes it. One agent, your data, everywhere.
homepage_eliza.marketing.dealStepThreeBo: Become the default operating system for the agent era, the trusted, open, sovereign base that everything else is built on. Red Hat economics on an open foundation. Access to intelligence for everyone.
homepage_eliza.marketing.dealBody: First the sovereign wedge, where openness is the requirement, not the pitch. Then every agent device. Open core forever; enterprise support and hosted cloud are the business.
